items.why: הגריד-חי-ומוכח (36/36-רשתות · µ-sim זורם) אך-חסום-בכנות: commitable 3.286 STEEM < 5.00-נדרש (מדיניות: 5-רמות × 1.0-מינימום). נזיל-בפועל 4.151 STEEM + 0.824 SBD — חסר 1.405 STEEM (צד-מכירה) ו-4.74 SBD (צד-קנייה). powerdown-כבוי (withdraw_rate=0 — דלק-החמישי-בשבוע-לא-יגיע-לבד) · המרת-SBD=הכרעת-venue-שמורה-לבעלים (אסורי-הצ׳רטר) · חתימת-עסקאות-אמת=R81-owner-gate (STEEM_ACTIVE_WIF-לא-חמוש-בשום-מקום-בכוונה).
items.what: בחר-ואשר: (א) הפעל-powerdown-מחדש מהחשבון (active-authority — רק-אתה) (ב) אשר-venue-להמרת-SBD→STEEM (ג) חמש-STEEM_ACTIVE_WIF-בכספת-אם-רוצה-חתימה-אמת-ולא-רק-הצעות. עד-אז: הרשת-ממשיכה-מדודה-וכנה-30-דק׳ (µ-sim) ומפרסמת-חסימה-עם-המספרים-האמיתיים.
items.resolution: T-67 RELEASE: the 'no posts / no grid activity' complaint was DOUBLE-ROOTED — (1) grids/run.mjs never had chain code at all (local receipts said posted:gmv2… but IDs were local feed IDs — a false declaration, now renamed recorded:) and T-66's claimed first live post (gmv2ejo6i) NEVER EXISTED on chain (get_content = empty — caught and documented); (2) the posting keys existed in the repo-vault envelope all along. FIXED: Hive posting authority deployed+bit-verified; grids/run.mjs now broadcasts real posts (permlink saos-grid-<id>) with get_content verification and honest ok:false on any failure. REMAINING (real physics, operator-only): STEEM active-authority fuel (powerdown restart / SBD→STEEM venue / STEEM_ACTIVE_WIF) — no key exists on any machine we hold; the 5-STEEM×5-levels minimum is our own policy and can be adapted down when the trading grid gains a signing path. Until then the grid publishes REAL evidence posts to Hive (RC-gated ≈10h for first success) and the lighthouse mirrors everything.
